title: hearthily grilled Brazilian cheese-pull Tacos
description: A solo-dinner Brazilian dish that combines the flavors of grilled cheese, herbs, and spices with the comfort of a warm, fresh taco.
instructions: Preheat grill to 375°F (190°C) for medium-high heat, oil grates with melted butter.
In a small bowl, whisk together white wine vinegar, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper to make marinade.
In a large bowl, combine thinly sliced grilled skirt steak, chopped cilantro, and marinade; mix well to coat.
Grill steak for 3-5 minutes per side, or until slightly charred and cooked to desired level of doneness.
Warm corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by placing cooked steak onto warmed tortillas, topping with shredded queso fresco, and serving immediately.
Repeat process until all ingredients are used, garnishing with additional cilantro if desired.
Note: If using leftover steak, reheat it in a dry pan over medium heat until warmed through before assembling tacos.
